author: StraightG0lden
body:
It increases your stats if you choose not to have a follower at the start of the fight. So you have to leave your follower at your origin town. 

As for who uses it, BeoH and Deity can use it well. The bonus stats from the Eastern Mask stack with this so you can get extremely high atk and mag with it for a hybrid build. I'm not sure if it's actually worth not bringing a follower though.
